habitat: Well-developed riverine forest, lowland forest and moist woodland, feeding in the canopy of large fruiting trees.
summary: A large pied hornbill of the lowland forest, with a huge dusky bill and casque and pink facial skin. The underparts are the whiter of the large pied hornbills, and the underwings have white edges. The call is a loud, far-carrying waaaa-aaa-aaa-aaa-aaaaaa, like a crying baby, often from several birds at once. The sexes and the immature are not separated in this account.

similar.note: Crowned Hornbill is smaller, with a red bill that has a yellow base and plain dark grey-brown upperparts, not a huge dusky casque.

population.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^9=512 mature individuals (resident breeder); paper interval half–double → 256–1024.

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

bill.shape: huge and dusky, with a large casque

head.pattern: Pink facial skin. The bill is dusky, not yellow.

upperparts.pattern: Pied: dark upperparts and whiter underparts than the comparison species Newman names.

viewNotes.note: Huge dusky bill and casque, pink face, black upperparts and white underparts, usually in the canopy.
The pink face and the big casque dominate the front view.
Dark back. White underparts are not the rear mark.
Dark above. A separate upperwing pattern was not named.
White edges on the underwings, and more white on the underparts.

calls.description: A loud, far-carrying waaaa-aaa-aaa-aaa-aaaaaa, like a crying baby, often from several birds at once. The texts do not separate the sexes. Grade A from Kruger, near Skukuza.

research.note: Status is resident and all twelve months are listed. Newman calls it a common lowland resident. Silvery-cheeked Hornbill is the comparison in Newman and is not on the Kruger list, so it is not linked. Chick down, a sexed call and a flight photograph are gaps. The call is grade A from Kruger.
